name: The Adventuring Party
description: A band of adventurers gathers at the tavern — each a different race, wielding a different weapon. Work out who's who.
clues: Hawk goes with exactly one of Lyra, Sable, or Cleric.
Rat goes with neither Cleric nor Druid.
Lyra, Druid, and Hawk belong to different adventurers.

hints.text: From the clue “Rat goes with neither Cleric nor Druid” — Cleric can't go with Rat.
From the clue “Rat goes with neither Cleric nor Druid” — Druid can't go with Rat.
From the clue “Lyra, Druid, and Hawk belong to different adventurers” — Lyra can't go with Druid.
From the clue “Lyra, Druid, and Hawk belong to different adventurers” — Lyra can't go with Hawk.
From the clue “Lyra, Druid, and Hawk belong to different adventurers” — Druid can't go with Hawk.
In Class × Familiar, Druid must go with Cat — every other Familiar is already crossed out for it.
In Class × Familiar, Rat must go with Paladin — every other Class is already crossed out for it.
Cat goes with Druid, so Cleric can't go with Cat.
In Class × Familiar, Hawk must go with Cleric — every other Class is already crossed out for it.
Paladin goes with Rat, so it can't also go with Cat.
Paladin goes with Rat, so it can't also go with Hawk.
Cleric goes with Hawk, but Lyra doesn't, so Lyra doesn't go with Cleric.
Cat goes with Druid, but Lyra doesn't, so Lyra doesn't go with Cat.
In Adventurer × Class, Lyra must go with Paladin — every other Class is already crossed out for it.
In Adventurer × Familiar, Lyra must go with Rat — every other Familiar is already crossed out for it.
Paladin goes with Lyra, so Kael can't go with Paladin.
Paladin goes with Lyra, so Sable can't go with Paladin.
Rat goes with Lyra, so Kael can't go with Rat.
Rat goes with Lyra, so Sable can't go with Rat.
From the clue “Hawk goes with exactly one of Lyra, Sable, or Cleric” — Sable can't go with Hawk.
In Adventurer × Familiar, Hawk must go with Kael — every other Adventurer is already crossed out for it.
In Adventurer × Familiar, Sable must go with Cat — every other Familiar is already crossed out for it.
Kael goes with Hawk, so it can't also go with Cat.
Kael goes with Hawk, and Cleric goes with Hawk, so Kael goes with Cleric.
Druid goes with Cat, but Kael doesn't, so Kael doesn't go with Druid.
Sable goes with Cat, but Cleric doesn't, so Sable doesn't go with Cleric.
Sable goes with Cat, and Druid goes with Cat, so Sable goes with Druid.
